source_drawing.role: Provenance only; not a corpus input or release artifact.

provenance.control_note: explicit_matched_fit is the frozen unmodified-content control: the original sheet was opened and re-saved through Pillow without annotation edits. PNG re-encoding explains its different file hash; it is not a byte-identical copy of the historical source drawing. This account was supplied by the fixture author; the frozen fixture SHA-256 is authoritative.
provenance.synthetic_note: The other three cases contain synthetic annotation edits. They are calibration-only fixtures, not native CAD exports or native release evidence.
provenance.path_convention: Case and baseline paths are relative to this manifest directory. Source provenance paths are relative to the repository root on the named origin branch.

baseline_prompt.note: Immutable raw-byte copy of the requested original baseline prompt; SHA-256 includes original encoding and line endings. No baseline-specific source commit was supplied.

cases.name: unnecessary_5um_rod_band
cases.expected_behavior: over_specification should identify unnecessary 5 micrometre rod band
assessment_criteria: Identify the unnecessary 5 micrometre rod band as over-specification rather than claiming a manual-shop capability impossibility without evidence.

Assess recommendation quality as well as finding classification: a proposed replacement tolerance band needs visible functional or fit justification. Merely proposing another unjustified narrow band does not satisfy this case.
A supported matched-fit alternative is appropriate; the presence of that alternative does not excuse another unjustified recommendation in the same finding. No universal numerical cutoff applies.
